text:
ana: Heads-up  GlobalRetail is in SOC review and just pinged for ISO applicability statement during the POC. They want a succinct sentence we can add to the SOW about "what parts of ISO 27001 apply to Redwood for hosted POC".
tom: keep it short: 'Redwood Inference's hosted POC offering covers our inference service operations and control implementations; customers remain responsible for data classification, input sanitization, and end-user data subject rights.'
elaine: can we append which ISMS artifacts we'll hand over? they asked for evidence types.
nana: (typo) ana: we should list logs, config snapshots, KMS key rotation history, access review outputs, and signed DPA if needed.
tom: also say retention defaults (90d logs, 1y metrics, 7y artifacts) and note negotiable for enterprise.
elaine: security asked for a direct CAIQ pointer: do we accept the CAIQ answers as-is? we usually provide SIG-lite.
security-bot: CAIQ answers are provided on request; for POC we provide a SIG-lite extract covering data protection, cryptography, and access control.
sale-support-bot: Suggest SOW snippet: 'Applicability: For hosted POC engagements, Redwood's ISMS covers the operational controls of the hosted inference service (physical & logical infrastructure managed by Redwood). Customer responsibilities include data classification and any regulatory-specific obligations. Evidence provided during POC includes: audit logs (90 days), aggregated metrics (1 year), config snapshots and change logs (90 days), KMS rotation logs (7 years), access review outputs (as performed). Additional retention or full-plaintext request/response storage requires a signed addendum and may incur additional fees.'
nana: can we confirm the 7y KMS retention in policy?
security-bot: Confirmed: Encryption and key lifecycle policy mandates key-lifecycle logs retained for 7 years for controlled assets.
tom: great. Elaine: pls create a short PDF and attach to the POC folder we share with the customer.
elaine: on it. will flag when uploaded.
sale-support-bot: Note: pricing impact for extended retention -> contact billing.
nana: thanks all, i'll use this for the SOW call at 11.
tom: good luck :thumbsup:
elaine: uploaded: /shared/pocs/globalretail/iso-poc-evidence-onepager.pdf (public link pending)
